# Bundled SVG icon notices

The SVG sets in the pinned Zensical 0.0.66 wheel are redistributed unchanged from `zensical/templates/.icons`. Each set retains its own license; Zensical's MIT license does not replace these licenses.

| Directory | Authors / project | License and source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `material` | Pictogrammers contributors, including redistributed Google Material Design icons | [Pictogrammers Free License](https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign/blob/master/LICENSE), Apache 2.0 |
| `fontawesome` | Fonticons, Inc., Font Awesome Free 7.3.1 | [Font Awesome license](https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/blob/7.x/LICENSE.txt), SVG icons CC BY 4.0 |
| `octicons` | GitHub Inc. and contributors | [Octicons MIT](https://github.com/primer/octicons/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| `lucide` | Lucide contributors; portions from Cole Bemis / Feather | [Lucide ISC and Feather MIT](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| `simple` | Simple Icons contributors | [Simple Icons CC0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md) |

License texts were retrieved from the linked upstream projects on 2026-10-01. `CC-BY-4.0.txt` contains the [Creative Commons legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt). The Apache 2.0 text is included separately in the release. Font Awesome copyright comments remain inside its SVG files. Brand marks retain their respective ownership.

The package also includes notices for the UI's separately installed Lucide version, fonts, Python runtime, Markdown libraries, KaTeX, Mermaid, DOMPurify and MathJax.
